description: This pie chart illustrates the time cost associated with efficient deployment methods compared to the time reduction achieved. The chart consists of two distinct slices. The larger slice, colored orange, is labeled "Reduction" just outside the chart and contains the text "60.9s (69.92%)" within the segment. The smaller slice, colored blue, is labeled "Efficient deployment" outside the chart and contains the text "26.2s (30.08%)" inside. The blue slice is visually emphasized by being offset, or exploded, from the main body of the pie. There is no separate legend included; instead, category labels are positioned adjacent to their respective slices, with absolute time values and percentage labels provided directly inside the segments. Visually, the slices are presented with the larger orange segment taking up the majority of the chart.

The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment."
